title: Fed signals 50 basis point rate cut as inflation cools to 2.4%
text: The Federal Reserve signaled a larger than expected interest rate cut after new data showed inflation cooled to 2.4%, boosting hopes of a soft landing for the economy.

title: BREAKING: Microsoft to acquire cybersecurity startup SecureNova for $12 billion
text: Microsoft announced a $12 billion acquisition of cybersecurity firm SecureNova, its largest deal this year, as it races to expand enterprise security offerings.

title: Nvidia shares surge 8% after record data-center revenue beats estimates
text: Nvidia reported record data-center revenue that crushed analyst estimates, sending shares up 8% in early trading as AI chip demand shows no signs of slowing.

title: OPEC+ surprise production cut escalates trade tensions with Washington
text: OPEC+ announced a surprise oil production cut of 1 million barrels per day, escalating geopolitical tensions with Washington and sending crude prices up 5%.

title: Regional lender Pacific Crest Bank files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
text: Pacific Crest Bank filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection after a failed recapitalization, in the largest regional bank failure since 2023. Regulators are monitoring contagion risk.

title: Apple unveils iPhone 17 Pro with on-device AI, orders up 30% on launch day
text: Apple unveiled the iPhone 17 Pro featuring on-device AI models, with pre-orders up 30% versus last year on launch day, easing concerns about a slow product cycle.

title: Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley face DOJ probe over bond trading practices
text: The Department of Justice opened an investigation into bond trading practices at Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, examining whether traders misled clients on bond prices.

title: Boeing supplier Spirit AeroSystems warns of supply chain disruption into 2027
text: Spirit AeroSystems warned of extended supply chain disruption that could delay Boeing 737 production into 2027, citing shortages of critical fuselage parts.

title: Amazon announces record Prime Day sales, beats guidance by $4 billion
text: Amazon announced record Prime Day sales beating its own guidance by $4 billion, with strong growth in advertising revenue and third-party seller services.

title: SEC charges Tesla with disclosure failures over autonomous driving claims
text: The SEC charged Tesla with disclosure failures regarding its autonomous driving claims, alleging the company overstated capability timelines to investors. Shares slipped 3%.

title: US slaps fresh sanctions on chip exports, hitting Nvidia and AMD sales in China
text: The US imposed fresh export sanctions on advanced AI chips to China, dealing a blow to Nvidia and AMD sales in one of their largest markets amid rising geopolitical conflict.

title: Johnson & Johnson wins major lawsuit over talc claims, shares rally
text: Johnson & Johnson won a major court ruling over talc litigation claims, removing a key legal overhang and sending shares up 4% in afternoon trading.

title: Walmart raises full-year forecast as discounting wins over high-income shoppers
text: Walmart raised its full-year profit forecast, saying gains with higher-income households continued even as inflation pressures ease for consumers.

title: Caterpillar profit warning: construction slowdown drags Q3 revenue lower
text: Caterpillar issued a profit warning as a construction slowdown dragged quarterly revenue lower, with dealers reporting shrinking order backlogs.

title: Exxon Mobil pledges $20 billion expansion in Gulf coast refining
text: Exxon Mobil announced a $20 billion expansion of Gulf coast refining and chemical operations, calling it a major growth investment despite energy transition headwinds.

title: Global market selloff: stocks plunge as recession fears grip investors
text: A global market selloff intensified as stocks plunged on recession fears, with volatility spiking to its highest level in eighteen months.

title: Moody's downgrades Chevron credit rating on weak cash flow outlook
text: Moody's downgraded Chevron's credit rating by one notch, citing a weak cash flow outlook and rising debt, in a surprise move for the oil major.

title: Meta unveils compact AR glasses at developer conference, stock jumps
text: Meta unveiled compact augmented reality glasses at its developer conference to strong reviews, and the stock jumped 5% as analysts flagged a new growth frontier.

title: Coca-Cola recall: contamination scare triggers nationwide product recall
text: Coca-Cola issued a nationwide recall of select beverage batches after a contamination scare, a rare quality crisis for the consumer giant.

title: Pfizer wins FDA approval for breakthrough cancer therapy
text: Pfizer won FDA approval for its breakthrough cancer therapy after a record-fast review, a major win for its oncology pipeline.

title: Massive ransomware attack disrupts operations at major US banks
text: A massive ransomware attack disrupted wire operations at several major US banks, exposing cybersecurity weaknesses across the financial sector.

title: JPMorgan reports record quarterly profit, lifts dividend and buyback
text: JPMorgan reported record quarterly profit on strong trading and lending revenue, lifting its dividend and announcing a $30 billion share buyback.

title: Disney+ subscriber growth accelerates, streaming turns first full-year profit
text: Disney+ subscriber growth accelerated and the streaming business turned its first full-year profit, easing pressure on CEO succession plans.

title: Trump administration proposes sweeping tariffs on European auto imports
text: The administration proposed sweeping tariffs of up to 25% on European auto imports, escalating trade conflict with the EU and pressuring global automakers.

title: Visa and Mastercard face antitrust lawsuit over debit card interchange fees
text: Visa and Mastercard face a sweeping antitrust lawsuit over debit interchange fees, with regulators seeking structural remedies.

title: Bank of America warns of rising consumer loan defaults among subprime borrowers
text: Bank of America warned of rising consumer loan defaults among subprime borrowers as household savings dwindle, setting aside an extra $1.2 billion provision.

title: Alphabet's Google debuts next-gen AI chip for data centers at cloud summit
text: Google debuted its next-generation tensor processing unit for data centers at its cloud summit, claiming a 3x performance leap over rivals.

title: McDonald's expands value menu globally as traffic rebounds in Asia
text: McDonald's announced a global expansion of its value menu as store traffic rebounded strongly across Asia, and reaffirmed full-year guidance.
